'''Tee-muss''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of domesticated [[Farm/Legends|farm]] animals native to the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. They were located on various worlds around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;such as [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]&mdash;because of domestication purposes or to serve as mounts.

==Description==
Tee-muss were four legged odd-toed [[ungulate]].<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=news/felucia-cellophane-flowers-of-yellow-and-green-and-rancors|text=Felucia: Cellophane Flowers Of Yellow And Green&hellip;And Rancors|nolive=1}}</ref> They had a short proboscis and two tusks on their lower jaw. Their ears were long and normally bent and pointed outward,<ref name=":1">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> when the tee-muss was attacked or threatened, they pointed downward. The call of a tee-muss was an excellent transmitter for warnings.<ref name=":0" />

==History==
[[Casiss/Legends|Casiss']] [[Akira/Legends|farming community]] used several as pack animals and mounts,<ref name=":1" /> most likely brought on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] since the animal was encountered on many planets<ref name=":0" /> including [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> and [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]].<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref> The tee-muss laid down for the rider to mount. The farmers later rode tee-musses in a [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|battle]] against [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] gang to defend their [[Nysillin/Legends|Nysillin]] crop from the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].<ref name=":1" />
